rules: Keys are the English pathology names (cond-name-eng) in DDXPlus release_conditions.json.
A pathology maps to a MediSync profile only when both name the same disease. Narrower, broader or merely related profiles are not accepted.
tier1_profile is an exact profile name from ml-engine/data/dataset.csv; tier2_profiles are exact names from disease_symptom_kb.v1.json.
null means MediSync has no profile for the pathology (not covered).

Acute COPD exacerbation / infection.reason: No COPD profile. Emphysema (Tier 2) is one COPD type, not an acute exacerbation.

Acute dystonic reactions.reason: No profile. Drug Reaction (Tier 1) is broader.

Acute pulmonary edema.reason: No profile. Fluid overload (Tier 2) is a different condition.

Acute rhinosinusitis.reason: Acute sinusitis and acute rhinosinusitis are the same disease (ICD-10 J01).

Allergic sinusitis.reason: No allergic rhinitis profile. Allergy (Tier 1) is broader.

Anaphylaxis.reason: No anaphylaxis profile. Allergy (Tier 1) is broader.

Bronchitis.reason: DDXPlus codes it J40 (not specified as acute or chronic); Acute bronchitis (Tier 2, J20) is narrower.

Bronchospasm / acute asthma exacerbation.reason: An asthma exacerbation is asthma (ICD-10 J45); the Tier 2 name is the same condition.

Chronic rhinosinusitis.reason: No chronic sinusitis profile. Acute sinusitis (Tier 2) is a different disease.

Cluster headache.reason: No profile. Migraine is a different headache disorder.

HIV (initial infection).reason: No profile. AIDS (Tier 1) is the late stage of HIV, not the initial infection.

Influenza.reason: No influenza profile. Common Cold (Tier 1) is a different disease.

Localized edema.reason: No profile. Fluid overload (Tier 2) is a different condition.

Panic attack.reason: No profile. Acute stress reaction and Social phobia (Tier 2) are different conditions.

Pneumonia.reason: Same disease name in both tiers.

Possible NSTEMI / STEMI.reason: NSTEMI and STEMI are acute myocardial infarction (ICD-10 I21), which is a heart attack.

Spontaneous pneumothorax.reason: Pneumothorax (Tier 2) is broader (it includes traumatic pneumothorax); broader profiles are not accepted.

Stable angina.reason: No angina profile. Heart attack is a different event.

URTI.reason: Common Cold (Tier 1) is one kind of upper respiratory infection, so it is narrower.

Unstable angina.reason: No angina profile. Heart attack is a different event.

Viral pharyngitis.reason: No profile. Strep throat (Tier 2) is bacterial.
